Chris Do  So here are segments that stood out as ‘solid advice’.  0:00-0:27 Intro 0:50-1:07 Share the Skool movement  1:20 How to prepare your portfolio Intro 1:34-2:06, 2:43-2:53, 2:55-3:21 Importance of IDEO’s T-Skill 4:39-5:08 The ‘Good’ Kabob analogy (Importance of IDEO’s T-Skill) 5:37-5:59 Going deep with your Core skill (Importance of IDEO’s T-Skill) 6:08-6:43 A Sample website (Importance of IDEO’s T-Skill) 7:20 Edit Intro 7:40-8:08 8:14-8:21 Getting to the point Fast 8:35-9:06 Aligning what you do With the company you want to work in 9:34-9:55 Exceptions to IDEO’s T-Skill (BuzzFeed Story 11:33-12:26) 10:06-10:24 The issue with such exceptions 11:02 Match & Mirror the work (and People) you want to do business with ( could be part of "Aligning what you do With the company you want to work in") 12:56-13:54 Summary   As I was watching it again, I noticed that generally, the episode could be broken down into a) what to Do (example 1:34-2:06, 2:43-2:53) and b) what Not to do (Example 2:55-3:21).   Everything after 13:54 could probably be a separate video. It would also be nice if you showed a screenshot of an actual site (when you are talking about importance of T-Skill).  Hope this helps. All best in your next episode. Good job.
